messages.subject: Re: mitten sizing
messages.text:
Hello Patricia,
 

 Based on your hand measurements, I would recommend going with size S for the mittens. A slightly looser fit, especially in winter gear, can be beneficial as it allows for better air circulation around the fingers, which helps to keep them warmer. This size should provide you with the warmth and comfort you need while walking your dog.
 

 The other advantages of doing this is you can put on a thin pair of gloves inside your mittens. So, if you need more dexterity for a task, you can remove your milkweed mitten without freezing 😊
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Gabriel 
 Co-founder 
 Lasclay

messages.text:
Hi Patricia,
 Sorry for the longer than usual response time. Your email got stuck in our spam folder!
 

 Here is the procedure for a return/exchange: 
 

 1. Go to https://lasclay.happyreturns.com/ to obtain a return label. After entering your order number and zip code, select the products to return and then choose the ones you want in exchange. At the end, you will receive a prepaid return label.
 

 2. Print the label, pack the products to be returned, and stick the label on the package. Please prefer using envelopes/bags instead of boxes, which are more expensive.
 

 3. Drop it off in a Canada Post red box or at the nearest post office.
 

 4. Once the return is received, if applicable to your case, we will either ask you to pay a $9.99 exchange fee, or if not applicable, we will ship your new products for free! 😊
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Gabriel 
 Co-founder 
 Lasclay

 Sorry for the longer than usual response time. Your email got stuck in our spam folder!
 

 Here is the procedure for a return/exchange: 
 

 1. Go to https://lasclay.happyreturns.com/ to obtain a return label. After entering your order number and zip code, select the products to return and then choose the ones you want in exchange. At the end, you will receive a prepaid return label.
 

 2. Print the label, pack the products to be returned, and stick the label on the package. Please prefer using envelopes/bags instead of boxes, which are more expensive.
 

 3. Drop it off in a Canada Post red box or at the nearest post office.
 

 4. Once the return is received, if applicable to your case, we will either ask you to pay a $9.99 exchange fee, or if not applicable, we will ship your new products for free! 😊
